options.content:
**Scope & caveats:**

- **All AI figures on this dashboard are Claude Code OTel-only**, scoped to the Project and Claude Code OTel Teams filters above. Legacy Claude Admin-API and Cursor activity are excluded — neither carries a reliable per-project mapping, so mixing them in would make these comparisons incomparable to the project-scoped panels elsewhere in the AI dashboard set. The human (merged-PR) side of every comparison below is scoped to the same Project filter, so both sides of each ratio move together.
- **AI-Attributed Share of Lines Changed** compares two different populations: AI-session activity counts lines touched *inside* AI tool sessions (whether or not that code is ever committed or merged), while the human side counts lines in *merged* PR diffs only. This structurally overstates AI's share, since AI-touched lines aren't verified as AI-authored and can be edited or discarded by a developer before ever being committed. Read the percentage as an upper bound on AI's contribution, not a precise attribution.
- **AI-Attributed Volume by Language** is queried directly from Claude Code's raw OTel telemetry rather than the shared domain layer — the unified AI-tool-decisions table drops the language column that OTel's raw telemetry carries.

panels.description: AI-session lines added ÷ (AI-session lines added + merged-PR additions), both sides scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). Compares two different populations — see the caveat above — so read this as an upper bound on AI's contribution, not an exact attribution.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ai.ai_lines / NULLIF(ai.ai_lines + human.human_lines, 0), 1) AS "AI-Attributed Share %"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS ai_lines FROM ai_activities
   WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
     AND source_connection_id IN (
       SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
       INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
       WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
     )
     AND $__timeFilter(date)) ai,
  (SELECT SUM(pr.additions) AS human_lines FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
   WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) human

panels.title: AI-Attributed Share of Lines Changed

panels.description: Distinct engineers with Claude Code OTel activity ÷ distinct name-deduplicated PR-merging contributors, both sides scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). The two counts aren't cross-matched to the same identity — an AI user isn't verified to also be a PR-merging contributor — so this is a directional adoption trend rather than an exact percentage, and can read above 100% when the two populations diverge.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ai.n / NULLIF(c.n, 0), 1) AS "Engineers Adopted %"
FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) n FROM ai_activities
   WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
     AND source_connection_id IN (
       SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
       INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
       WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
     )
     AND $__timeFilter(date) AND user_email != '') ai,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) n FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) c

panels.title: Engineers Adopted %

panels.description: Total lines added inside Claude Code OTel sessions, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`SUM(ai_activities.lines_added)`).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS "AI Lines Added"
FROM ai_activities
WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
  AND source_connection_id IN (
    SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
    INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
    WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  )
  AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: AI Lines Added

panels.description: Accepted Claude Code OTel edit-tool decisions ÷ decisions offered, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s) (`ai_tool_decisions`, which only Claude Code OTel writes to).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(accepted_count) / NULLIF(SUM(accepted_count) + SUM(rejected_count), 0), 1) AS "Edit Acceptance %"
FROM ai_tool_decisions
WHERE source_connection_id IN (
  SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
  WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
)
AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Edit Acceptance %
Share of Lines Changed, With Adoption

panels.description: Weekly share of lines changed attributed to AI sessions vs. merged human PR diffs, stacked to 100%, both sides scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). Engineers Adopted % is overlaid as a dashed line for reference, on its own scale since adoption typically runs well above code-share percentage. Bucketed weekly rather than monthly since Claude Code OTel history is currently short. Carries the same population caveat as the AI-Attributed Share of Lines Changed KPI above.

targets.rawSql:
WITH weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS week
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (
      SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
      INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
      WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(date)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
),
ai_w AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') week, SUM(lines_added) v
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (
      SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
      INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
      WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
hu_w AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') week, SUM(pr.additions) v
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
  GROUP BY 1
),
ai_users_w AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') week, COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) n
  FROM ai_activities
  WHERE record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND source_connection_id IN (
      SELECT cp.connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
      INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
      WHERE cp.project_name IN ($project) AND c.team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(date) AND user_email != ''
  GROUP BY 1
),
contrib_w AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') week, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) n
  FROM project_pr_metrics ppm JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = ppm.id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE ppm.project_name IN ($project) AND pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(w.week, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, 'AI-attributed' AS metric,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ai_w.v, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ai_w.v, 0) + COALESCE(hu_w.v, 0), 0), 1) AS value
FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN ai_w ON ai_w.week = w.week LEFT JOIN hu_w ON hu_w.week = w.week
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(w.week, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Human',
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(hu_w.v, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ai_w.v, 0) + COALESCE(hu_w.v, 0), 0), 1)
FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN ai_w ON ai_w.week = w.week LEFT JOIN hu_w ON hu_w.week = w.week
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(w.week, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Engineers adopted',
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(au.n, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(c.n, 0), 0), 1)
FROM weeks w LEFT JOIN ai_users_w au ON au.week = w.week LEFT JOIN contrib_w c ON c.week = w.week
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: AI vs Human Share of Lines Changed (Weekly), With Adoption
AI-Attributed Volume by Language (Claude Code OTel only)

panels.description: Weekly accepted-edit volume by programming language, from Claude Code OTel telemetry, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s). Plugin-internal source — the shared AI-tool-decisions table doesn't carry a language dimension. Bucketed weekly rather than monthly since Claude Code OTel history is currently short.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(hour_start), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(hour_start) DAY) AS time, language AS metric, SUM(accepted_count) AS value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_tool_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
  AND team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  AND connection_id IN (
    SELECT connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects WHERE project_name IN ($project)
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY metric, time

panels.title: Accepted Edits by Language (Weekly)

panels.description: Exact accepted/rejected edit totals by language from the same Claude Code OTel source as the chart above, scoped to the selected project(s)/team(s), with a per-language acceptance-rate column.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT language AS "Language", SUM(accepted_count) AS "Accepted Edits", SUM(rejected_count) AS "Rejected Edits",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(accepted_count) / NULLIF(SUM(accepted_count) + SUM(rejected_count), 0), 1) AS "Acceptance %"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_tool_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
  AND team_slug REGEXP '^(${otel_teams:regex})$'
  AND connection_id IN (
    SELECT connection_id FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects WHERE project_name IN ($project)
  )
GROUP BY language
ORDER BY SUM(accepted_count) DESC

panels.title: Accepted / Rejected Edits by Language (Totals)

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;
list.label: Project
list.name: project
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS __text, p.name AS __value
FROM projects p
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp ON cp.project_name = p.name
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connections c ON c.id = cp.connection_id
INNER JOIN user_project_mapping upm ON upm.project_name = p.name
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND upm.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring}
ORDER BY p.name;

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$'
ORDER BY c.team_slug;
list.label: Claude Code OTel teams
list.name: otel_teams
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c.team_slug AS __text,
    c.team_slug AS __value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connections AS c
INNER JOIN _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects AS cp
    ON cp.connection_id = c.id
WHERE c.status = 'active'
  AND cp.project_name REGEXP '^(${project:regex})$'
ORDER BY c.team_slug;
